screen.subject: 地域イベント 本日の流れ
screen.line: 雨天時：日程を一日早める

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 15: 25 words — getting work done.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a phone call from an event site.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Hello, Kimura speaking.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: It's Nakamura. I've just arrived on site. Let me check how today's work will go.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Sure. There are many elderly people in the area, so first we'll have residents try it out.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: I see. It's the session for the new app, right?
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Yes. We'll explain it so that even people who don't use smartphones day to day can follow.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Does the official website give the designated venue?
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Yes. But to avoid confusion if it rains, we've decided to bring the schedule forward a day.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Oh, that contradicts the current materials.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Sorry, I'll fix it right away. Also, we've decided to limit the explanation to thirty minutes.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Good measure. Listening to someone else talk for a long time is tiring.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Yes. This session is, so to speak, our connection with the community itself.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: True. Getting ideas for the next project from participants is an important part of it, too.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: If we really are short of people, I'll take on reception.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Thanks. I'll get started on the preparations then. Let's all work on this properly as a team.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: schedules & flow.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A formal way to say 今日 (today).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you for coming today.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: The schedule for work or an event.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The schedule for the business trip has been set.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Moving a time or date earlier.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Let's bring the meeting forward an hour.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: How things proceed, and in what order.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll explain the workflow with a diagram.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: The actual place where something is.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll check on site tomorrow.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Clearly specifying something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please fill in the designated form.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Officially recognised.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: See the official website for details.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: New.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We made a new plan.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Next: taking it on.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Throwing yourself into something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The team will tackle a new challenge.
lines.name: 中村

segments.meaning: to set about, get started on

lines.en: Getting started on a task.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: After lunch I'll get started on the materials.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Taking on what you were asked to do.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll take that job on.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Working with your hands or head.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This afternoon I'm working in the warehouse.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Steps taken to deal with a problem.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll think of measures to prevent accidents.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Keeping away from something bad.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll leave early to avoid the crowds.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Setting a limit and not going beyond it.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Participants are limited to twenty.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Getting or gaining something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I gained a lot of experience from this job.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Trying something out for yourself.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We tried making things at the factory.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Last: ways of thinking.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: People other than yourself.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Value other people's opinions too.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: An everyday, routine thing.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I use Japanese every day.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Being elderly.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I speak slowly with elderly customers.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: When the parts of a story don't fit together.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The two documents contradict each other.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: An important part that makes something up.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Trust is an important element of business.
lines.name: 木村

segments.meaning: so to speak, as it were

lines.en: So to speak.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This shop is, so to speak, the town's kitchen.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: The thing itself.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll rethink the plan itself.
lines.name: 木村

segments.meaning: by all means, at any cost

lines.en: No matter what.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I really want to finish this job today, no matter what.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Let's ___ the meeting by an hour.

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 早め, bring forward.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Which means taking on what you were asked to do?

lines.en: Question 2. Which means taking on what you were asked to do?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 引き受ける.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 3. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: 矛盾, contradict.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 4. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 公式, official.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Which is a formal way to say 今日?

lines.en: Question 5. Which is a formal way to say 今日?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 本日.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today we studied 25 words: getting work done.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Review them again in the app's word list.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Good work today. See you in the next lesson.
lines.name: ナレーター
